text:
maria: Quick async check — trying to onboard new open model aurelia-2.7B into the catalog. License scan shows Apache-2.0 OK, but perf on long context (8k) is noisy on A100-80GB. Need owners for quantization perf runs and routing policy decisions. Who can pick this up? :wave:

dan: I can run the int8/pt-quant jobs. Do you have a reproducible invocation or failing log? :eyes:

maria: Repro is a synthetic long-context eval we run for stability. Tail latency spikes around 6k+ tokens. Short logs: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z WARN tail_latency  p99=1.8s p99.9=6.2s
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z INFO  batch_size=8 seq=8192 kv_hits=low
```

li: @maria paste the model manifest so I can run shape/embedding checks. Also which sampling settings did you use? For quant perf, I usually run `--perplexity-check` and `--kv-sim` to isolate memory churn.

maria: manifest below — it's a trimmed intake fragment: 
```
manifest: {
  "model": "aurelia-2.7b",
  "variant": "v1-open",
  "weights_sha256": "b2f3...9a8",
  "max_seq": 8192,
  "default_dtype": "fp16"
}
```

ashley: legal-bot earlier flagged an attribution note, but legal confirmed Apache is OK as long as we include upstream URL + SHA in the catalog entry. I'll follow up with the provenance doc. :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: legal: License confirmed (Apache-2.0). Please attach upstream repo URL, model card, and weights SHA256 to the intake form. No further restrictions.

carol: @infra can we spin a dedicated canary for this model? I'd like 2x concurrency with profiling enabled to capture kernel-level hot spots.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary created — `canary-aurelia-3925001234`. Routing bucket: 1% traffic, 2 instances (2x concurrency), profiling ON.

ben: I can own routing policy. Proposal: route short prompts (<1k tokens) to int8-quant variant, and fallback to fp16 for requests with >=6k tokens or when p99 latency > 2s. Will draft a policy doc and a small rollout plan.

maria: perfect. I'll add action items and update the intake check. Current action list: 
1) dan — run int8/pt quant + perf logs (due Wed)
2) li — run embedding/shape validation + regen manifest tests (due Tue)
3) ben — draft routing policy + canary thresholds (due Thu)
4) ashley/legal — attach provenance doc to catalog entry (due Thu)
5) carol/infra — confirm canary perf traces and GPU kernel flame (done)

maria: If anyone needs infra creds or canary knobs, ping @carol and @dan directly. Thanks all — will follow up with a short PR to the catalog intake once Dan posts logs. :sparkles:
